comments.author: somtam
comments.body_html:
Thanks for testing it.

All the mod does is patch into ApplyDamageInfo, so its intercepting the damage tarkov is trying to apply to a player.

You can set the damage to zero to make yourself invincible.

The mod has not control of, and doesn’t affect the generation of the damage (from what I understand).

But it does mean that you might have to set the damage offset really high if you are getting multiple head damage events from one bullet.

Maybe its bullet fragment? It seems legit because each incoming damage is different. If it was 4 damage events with the exact same damage value then it would be much more suspicious!

comments.author: somtam
comments.body_html:
Takes headshot damage and spreads it out across body parts.

However you can still get one shot. Your head won’t be damaged but multiple body parts can go black and you can still die.

If this is happening you can lower the damage damage to the head using sliders.

Maybe just check only limbs for damage redirection, that way your thorax an stomach won’t instantly go black and you die

Enable the message logs as well and then check the bepin ex logs, you can see what damage is being applied.

I’m still play testing the mod myself.
